versions.content: The FrIf module shall pad transmitted PDUs that are located on a FrIf L-Sdu where FrIfAllowDynamicLSduLength is set to false, if the size is smaller than the configured size of the PDU. Padding shall be done with the configured FrIfUnusedBitValue.
